snippet.title: Rekindled Trails - Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Discover a strange land in this Cozy Adventure game! You are tasked with bringing back light to a dark world by rebuilding ruined towns and selling faraway goods. With the help of your mysterious fire companion, you will gather items, explore, and eventually unite the people!
Rekindled Trails will be available in June 2025, so head over to Steam and add the game to your Wishlist.
